verdict.rationale: Stripe's hosted MCP server lets an agent read any Stripe API GET method, and its documented supported-method list explicitly includes payouts and balance transactions. The `stripe_report` tool can generate balance and payouts report runs as downloadable CSVs, and the payouts docs confirm that payouts move funds from the Stripe balance to the bank account. The evidence does not show the per-deposit linkage, i.e. listing a payout's balance transactions back to their source charges, so reconciliation is only implied. Missing for 10: documented payout-to-charge reconciliation (e.g. filtering balance transactions by payout or a payout reconciliation report), an end-to-end agent reconciliation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
